styles.vignette: A small, quiet watercolor vignette painted on thick textured cold-press paper. The painting fills only the middle of the sheet, with wide blank off-white paper all around it. The scene sits inside a {shape} with soft, hand-painted, slightly uneven edges, no outline and no frame. Flat layered transparent washes, visible paper grain and pigment granulation, gentle blooms, very simple shapes and silhouettes, minimal detail. Muted earthy palette of yellow ochre, sage green, terracotta, slate blue and warm grey. Calm, cozy, storybook mood. Subject: {scene}. No text, no signature, no border.
styles.inkwash: A loose sketchbook illustration: confident thin black ink linework with fresh watercolor washes over it, lots of white paper showing, vignette edges that fade unfinished into textured cold-press paper. Bright daylight palette of sky blue, terracotta, leafy green and warm sand. Subject: {scene}. No text, no signature.
styles.dreamy: A dreamy painterly illustration in a vertical card format, full bleed. The background is made of visible impressionist brush dabs in soft pastel violet, pink and blue. One small whimsical subject in dark silhouette with a few warm accents, slightly surreal and poetic, gentle light. Subject: {scene}. No text, no border.

layers.ground: A small, quiet watercolor vignette on thick textured cold-press paper, inside a tall arched window shape with soft hand-painted edges, wide blank off-white paper around it. Only an empty landscape background: a calm lake at dusk, soft peach and slate-blue sky, low distant sage hills, a pale low sun. No animals, no buildings, no boats, no plants in the foreground. Flat layered transparent washes, paper grain, muted earthy palette. No text, no border.
layers.piece: A single {object}, painted in loose transparent watercolor with flat simple washes and soft edges, muted earthy palette of slate grey, ochre, sage and terracotta, visible paper grain. The object is isolated in the center of a plain pure white background, with no ground, no shadow, no scenery and nothing else in the image. No text.

variants.prompt: A polished screenshot of a cozy mobile idle game called Colortime, portrait phone screen, one-thumb layout, crisp readable game UI. Top: a round 'Studio level 7' badge with an XP ring, a small paint tin holding three pigment counters (red 13.9K, yellow 3.8K, blue 18.6K), and an envelope button with a red '2' badge. Below it, the current goal: a small arched watercolor vignette of a grey heron at dusk, only its bottom third painted in color and the rest still a pencil sketch, labelled 'Quiet Heron 32%'. Center, the largest element: a round clock-like color wheel made of four concentric rings (red outer, yellow, blue, green inner) that fill up clockwise like clock hands, with thin dotted blend seams of orange, green and teal between the rings, a single clock hand and a wooden hub. A floating '+37' in red and paint droplets flying from the wheel to the counters; a small butterfly fluttering beside the wheel; a round 'x2' golden-hour button on the left. Bottom: an upgrade card shaped like a paper tag reading 'Rim Runner 5, outer ring +10% speed' with a chunky buy button costing 800, a green workshop button with a red '3' badge, and a bottom bar of five round buttons for Studio, Research, Easel, Gallery and Shop. Art style: watercolor on textured rice paper, muted ochre, terracotta, slate blue and sage, soft bleeding edges and pigment granulation, thick dark-brown outlines and chunky hard drop shadows on buttons, warm and handmade, like a hand-painted storybook game.

blend.prompt: Combine the two reference images into one mobile game screen. Image 1 sets the interface and its text: the 'Studio level 7' badge, the paint tin with counters 13.9K, 3.8K and 18.6K, the envelope with a red 2, the color wheel with four rings, clock hands and dotted blend seams, the '+37', the butterfly, the x2 button, the 'Rim Runner 5' tag with a Buy 800 button, the Workshop button with a red 3, and the bottom bar Studio, Research, Easel, Gallery, Shop. Change one thing from image 1: the heron painting is no longer a large card under the header. It becomes a small sheet of paper, about a fifth of the screen width, taped at a slight angle in the top-right area just below the header with a strip of washi tape. Its bottom third is painted in color and the rest is a pencil sketch, with a tiny '32%' written beside it. The color wheel moves up into the space this frees and becomes the clear centerpiece, as large as the screen width allows. Image 2 sets the material and light: render the whole screen as real watercolor and gouache painted by hand on thick textured paper, seen straight from above on a wooden painter's desk in warm window light. Visible paper grain, pigment pooling at the edges of each wash, slightly uneven hand-painted rings, soft real shadows under the taped sheet, the labels and the buttons. Keep it a flat, readable, portrait phone screen filling the frame. No phone frame, no hands.

main-v2.prompt: Keep this game screen exactly as it is: the layout, the real watercolor-on-paper style, the wooden desk, the window light and all the text. Make only these three fixes. 1) Remove the second envelope with '-32%' on it; the only envelope is the one in the top-right corner with a red 2. 2) Keep only one round x2 button, the one on the left beside the wheel; remove the other x2 button. 3) On the small taped heron sheet, paint the bottom third in watercolor: blue-grey water, green reeds and the heron's legs and lower body in grey, ending in a soft wet edge. The top two thirds stay a pencil sketch. Keep a small handwritten '32%' beside the sheet.

studio-wall.prompt: Use the attached screen as the exact style reference: real watercolor and gouache on thick textured paper on a wooden desk in warm window light, with the same header, round buttons, paper tags, lettering and bottom bar. Draw a different screen of the same game: the Studio. Header as in the reference: the 'Studio level 7' badge, the paint tin with counters 13.9K, 3.8K and 18.6K, and the envelope with a red 2. A handwritten title 'Studio'. Below it, a torn paper banner reading 'While you were away: +48.2K' with two small buttons, 'Collect' and 'Double'. The main area is a large sheet of paper on the desk holding a grid of six small painted wheels, two across and three down. Each is a smaller version of the reference wheel with its own colors: warm reds and oranges; greens and blues; purples and violets; mostly yellows; teal and blue; and the sixth is an empty dotted pencil outline labelled 'Build wheel' with a small cost of 250K. Under each painted wheel, a small paper label: 'Wheel 1' to 'Wheel 5', each with a rate such as '312/s'. Wheel 1 is highlighted with a pencil circle. In the top-right corner of the desk, the small heron sheet from the reference stands on a tiny wooden easel, its bottom third painted and the rest a pencil sketch. Bottom bar as in the reference, Studio, Research, Easel, Gallery, Shop, with Studio highlighted. A flat, readable portrait phone screen filling the frame. No phone frame, no hands.
